title: A seal records the components its run reached
intention: When the tester seals a proof, the seal records which other components the run actually reached (by import, or by a python subprocess) and the seal state each was in, so a later move there can be seen from here.
traces_to: Law 9 via 1b6516f92db3 and parent 50e0581737e8. Law 3: reach is measured at runtime, never inferred from a static closure, which misses subprocess reach (the measured 5bc3 -> verdict-siblings case).
how: (a) cairn/devices/tester/reach/sitecustomize.py: when os.environ has CAIRN_TESTER_REACH_LOG, register an atexit that appends json.dumps({'pid': os.getpid(), 'files': sorted(m.__file__ for m in sys.modules.values() if under the cairn root)}) + newline to that path. Then chain-load the next sitecustomize on sys.path after this dir with importlib.util. It must import nothing from cairn (cairn/__init__.py stays import-free). (b) In _subject_env, prepend the reach dir to PYTHONPATH and set CAIRN_TESTER_REACH_LOG to runs.run_dir(test)/reached.jsonl. (c) At seal (~700-735), read the JSONL, map each file through grammar.component_of on its repo-relative path, drop unmapped files and the proof's own component, and set evidence['reached'] = {dir: validation_store.seal_digest(dir)} sorted by dir. (d) Proof at the path above, four teeth, PROVES keyed on this ticket, run under --netns.
falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_seal_records_what_it_reached.py is green under bin/cairn test --netns. (1) A fixture proof that imports cairn.tools.validation_store seals with that component's dir in evidence.reached, valued at its seal_digest. (2) A fixture proof whose subprocess runs `python -m` on a module of another component carries that component too. (3) A fixture proof that reaches nothing outside its own component carries reached == {}. (4) The shadowed system sitecustomize still runs (a marker it sets is visible in the child). Red at HEAD 4b3ac7f5: no reach dir, no evidence.reached.
